title: Malaysian Crumble Pork with Sour Cabbage
description: A delicious Chinese-inspired dish that combines the flavors of Malaysia with a crunchy crumble topping.
instructions: 2. Chop the onion and garlic and sauté them in a pan until softened.
3. Add the soy sauce and oyster sauce to the pan and stir to combine.
4. Add the sliced pork shoulder to the pan and cook until browned on all sides.
5. Transfer the pork mixture to a baking dish and set aside.
6. In a separate pan, heat the Malaysian rice until lightly toasted.
7. Add the sour cabbage to the pan and stir-fry until slightly caramelized.
8. Top the pork mixture with the toasted rice and cabbage mixture.
9. Sprinkle the crumble topping over the top of the dish.
10. Bake in the preheated oven for 25-30 minutes, or until the crumble topping is golden brown.
